Description: Best-preserved Qumran copy for Zechariah only. A Hebrew Twelve Prophets scroll from Qumran Cave 4, dated 75-50 BC, surviving in fragments. Its surviving portions are almost exclusively from Zechariah, with a short Haggai section at the end of Haggai 2.
Significance: Best-preserved Qumran biblical copy of Zechariah: it preserves parts of Zechariah 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 8 and 12, far more than 4Q76 (Zechariah 14:18 only) or 4Q82 (Zechariah 10-12 fragments). Its text is described as of a textual type related to the Septuagint. For Haggai it is the runner-up, not the best: Haggai 2:18-21 (four verses) against 4Q77's Haggai 1:1-2; 2:2-4 (five verses).
